reason: The hypothesis combines the fcc→hcp transformation mechanism from dual-phase TRIP studies (P1) with the grain boundary nanosegregation mechanism from single-phase ductility loss studies (P12, P23, P26) and applies them jointly to a single-phase HEA under demanding conditions, a synthesis not proposed in any single passage. It also extends the TRIP effect to the Cantor alloy under high strain rates, which P37 notes was previously unreported, and links these mechanisms to a toughness loss prediction that resolves the gap between dual-phase and single-phase behavior.
